description:
Latest GPU rental price index, in US dollars per GPU-hour.

Call this for the current median rental price of a GPU model, or for prices by GPU memory. Omit model for every published model plus the 16, 64, 256, and 512 GB tiers. Pass one model name for that model only.

On-demand is list price. Spot combines spot prices, interruptible prices, and marketplace asking prices. Each class has median_usd_per_gpu_hour, p25_usd_per_gpu_hour, p75_usd_per_gpu_hour, providers, and offers. A model is present only when at least two providers have recent offers. Memory-tier classes use median_usd_per_hour and median_usd_per_gb_hour with p25_usd_per_gb_hour and p75_usd_per_gb_hour. Unknown model: {"error": "not_found", "query", "models": [names]}.

model.description: GPU model name as published, for example H100 SXM. Empty returns every model and the memory tiers.

response_format.description: markdown (default) is a compact reading form. json is the object described below, with source numbers and omitted fields left out.

name: gpu_price_index
